title: Abundance validator scope and issuance guards
status: source guards and mocked/schema checks pass; capability not accepted
changes: Validator selection checks tier, slot count, and finite non-negative expertise threshold before SQL; it matches case-insensitive evaluator domain expertise to estimate categories, applies the requested weighted threshold, records expertise separately from trust, and samples with system randomness.
A validator review requires a selected, revealed evaluator in a committed/revealing/revealed/reviewing round, locking the selection row before inserting the review.
Quadratic votes reject invalid finite/range weights and unsupported vote types before SQL.
Coin issuance requires a finite positive impact score and locks a periodic-validation row whose status is validated or finalized before inserting an issued event.

verification.ruff: python3 -m ruff check services/abundance/validation.py services/abundance/economics.py tests/test_abundance_protocol.py: passed

scope_limits: Tests use mocked connections and schema files; no database or chain was used.
The existing commit/reveal path does not verify revealed payloads against a durable per-validator commitment. This remains open.
Exact category-name matching has no synonym mapping or owner-selected reference fixtures; funding/distribution rules, chain custody, populated parity, and tenant authorization remain unassessed.
